The vault, the weight, and the key.

This is a private, bonded settlement system for real assets — operating now to settle real transactions. Accounting is the product: every holding below is entered once, in its place, and reconciled to the record. The bond is the weight: the CBB3 bond and its clock carry the weight everything else is measured against. The pools are the conversion: the private pools are where bonded weight becomes usable settlement. And the proof is where the record is held — in corporate trust, with the institutions that hold it. The Treasury tells that story in three steps: HKMA guidance is why the vault exists, the VSVF vault is where the weight is held, and the BFT NFT key is how assets enter the post-quantum stack. The prefaces are not alternatives — Building, private and fiduciary, Universal OTC, and VERITAS are present together, at the same time, because MAP ThirdWeb Secure Connect is the system that holds them together. That Connect system is what “coming soon” points to on MAP. The treasury itself is nicknamed YANDEX — Youth and Novice Decentralized Ecosystem Xchange — and its current holdings, the SettleMint Trust A Fidelity record, and the VSVF ecosystem liquid value are set out on this page. All valuations are attested as stated, verified by the company's private department Ocean Audit, which operates as a part of Nova Spire and is a wholly owned operating subsidiary of OUTTHEFREEZER Limited — an affiliated operating subsidiary audit, not an independent third-party audit.

Tile 1 — The Why

HKMA Context

On November 2, 2026, HKMA post-quantum readiness guidance set the context this treasury is built in: financial infrastructure should be preparing now for post-quantum cryptography, before the migration is forced. This system was built for that horizon — a private, bonded settlement system for real assets, operating now on today's rails while securing tomorrow's state. Tile 1 is that reason — not a product, and not an endorsement.

  • Guidance → response: the vault and the key in Tiles 2 and 3 are the response built to that readiness framing.
  • Alignment, not endorsement: this page is aligned with that guidance. It is not endorsed by HKMA, HKUST, or any regulator.
  • Experimental by nature: post-quantum cryptography is experimental, and digital assets are volatile — see the disclosure below.

How to read this page: guidance first, then the vault that holds the weight, then the key that opens it. Accounting is the product, the bond is the weight, the pools are the conversion, and the institutions holding the record are the proof. CBB3 — a weighted energy node

The bond is the weight. You put in work, you get 60%. The network keeps 40%. The node keeps the facility weight — the network endpoint itself is not displayed on this page.

Work · 60%
Network · 40%

The BFT badge is the key that turns the 40% into cash when the community needs it. No key, no cash — so the network can't be drained. The 10B cap is not just a limit: it is the total weight the network can hold before it needs a new layer — NovaSpire.

  • Parent: SCBMSCBB3 Crypto-Bearer Bond
  • Child: CBB3 Tokens — fixed supply of 10 billion
  • S1 microprocessor: high-performance, secure processor for SLVR8 infrastructure — coming soon

Layer 3 — H3-256 ternary check

Your phone runs on 0s and 1s. SLVR8 logic runs on −1, 0, +1, checking three things at once. If one lies, the other two still work — that is the Byzantine Fault Tolerance design, and because it is three-way, it is instant.

−1The Bond 0The Token +1The BFT Key

The glass box: inside CBB3 are Bitcoin, Ethereum, the tokenomics, and EchoMind. You can't see them unless you have the BFT key. The S1 chip with H3-256 adds time, making the box 4D — the pieces move.

Tile 3 — The Access

The Key — BFT NFT CASH

BFT NFT CASH (ERC-1155) is infrastructure, not speculation. The NFT isn't the product — it's the access. Holding the NFT is the right to secure assets in the 0tc post-quantum validator mesh, to access smart-contract-regulated accrual under the H3-256 states, and to draw against the weight held in the vault — bonded weight in, settlement out. The NFT secures assets and enables accrual — it carries no guarantees.

  • What it is: a license key for access to the 0tc validator mesh and VSVF infrastructure.
  • What it is not: equity, debt, or an investment contract.
  • The gate: the same badge that opens the glass box is the key that releases the network's 40% — no key, no cash.
  • The Fauce pieces: the game gives out pieces of the box — collect all 7, receive 1,000 CBB3, and understand how the box works.

CBB3 bond clock — live from the verified daily table

Reading the verified daily table…

This clock keeps the value itself. At page open it reads the calendar date and looks the bond's value up in the verified daily table — and it looks up again whenever you step to another date below.

How the clock keeps the value: the clock carries the verified daily table itself — every day from October 25, 2025 to January 18, 2027, kept day by day in the bond record. For any date in that range the clock reads the value straight from the table — the same per-MWh and per-UTXO figures as the record, to the cent, never a re-computation. The table runs in 90-day cycles from October 25, 2025: at each rollover the cycle base rises 2.5% (base × 1.025), and inside a cycle the value accrues evenly, day by day. Past January 18, 2027 the clock extends the record with that same cycle formula — a new 90-day cycle at each rollover, base × 1.025, accruing day by day inside the cycle — so the value never has to be updated by hand. Bond depth is always 10,000,000,000 × the per-MWh value, and Total Ecosystem net value is bond depth + the ecosystem liquid value.

Two forms, one facility

  • Published index (Year 1): a global index in the MSCI style — published, dated, and read the same way by everyone.
  • Struck NAV (Year 2): a fund-style net asset value, licensed once the index record stands behind it.
  • Verification flow: S1 local measurement → Goose verifies → Hex attests → BTC notarizes → VERITAS L3 log, under H3-256 2-of-3 validation. No mint without attestation.
